maya: Quick design review — leaning into a more compact roles matrix for org-admin onboarding. Dropping a Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/compact-roles — can we validate spacing, labels, and SSO toggle placement? sam (design): I like the compact rows — we can fit 6 roles on smaller screens. Two quick asks: 1) show short role badges (e.g., "Admin") vs full description on hover, 2) collapse permissions under a chevron to reduce cognitive load. olivia (a11y): Heads up on contrast: current gray for secondary text is 3.8:1 vs BG. Need >=4.5:1 for body text. Also keyboard focus ring gets lost when row is collapsed — ensure a visible focus state on the chevron and row. jason: Implementation note: collapsing rows + keyboard nav is doable but will need a11y hooks. We'll need ARIA-expanded on the button and a live region for role changes. Example: ```
...
``` harper (pm): Microcopy: instead of "SSO toggle" label can we say "Require SSO for this role" — clearer for admins. Also propose a helper tooltip: "Must be enforced at org-level before enabling." liam (frontend): Agree with olivia — will update CSS variables for contrast tokens. For the compact layout, we should avoid truncating role names by default. Instead show ellipsis + tooltip on hover. That keeps screen readers happy. sam (design): For mobile, collapse the matrix into a list with a left-aligned role name and a right chevron. Keeps parity with other console lists. Also: add an inline "invite" CTA per row so admins can quickly send invites to that role. harper (pm): On invites: we should confirm whether invite modal pre-selects role and shows SSO enforcement notice. If we change copy, update the admin onboarding checklist and release notes. jason: API side: role payload can include `require_sso: boolean` and `display_short: string`. No breaking changes. We'll add an endpoint to preview effective permissions for a role id — helpful for the collapsed permissions view. olivia (a11y): Minor: ensure color isn't the only affordance for granted vs revoked perms — add icons (check / dash) + aria-label. And ensure the audit-log link is next to the role history header, not buried in the kebab menu. Screen reader users should get quick access. sam (design): Noted — will add check/dash icons and an SR-only label. I'll push an updated frame with larger focus rings and swapped tooltip copy. harper (pm): Timeline: can we target a design handoff end of week? engineering can estimate after that. Also, let's add a short user test with two admins to validate the invite flow wording. deploy-bot: stamp: design/compact-roles pushed to staging-preview — build 0.63.2. maya: Thanks everyone. Action items: sam update Figma + accessibility frames, jason estimate effort after handoff, olivia quick a11y checklist, harper schedule 2 admin tests. Ping here when frames are ready. :thumbsup:
